title: Who Plans, Who Edits? Verified, Cost-Aware Division of Labor for LLM-Driven Analog Layout Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.24234v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language-model agents can repair analog layouts when sign-off tools check every edit, but which model should plan a repair, which should edit it, and at what cost remain open questions. In our tool-grounded repair agent, models only choose bounded layout operators; sign-off tools rerun each task's contract checks after every edit, so failing layouts are never accepted. On layout-versus-schematic (LVS), design-rule checking (DRC), and post-layout repairs of three designs (a production high-voltage digital-to-analog converter (DAC), a 5-V oscillator, and a SKY130 operational transconductance amplifier (OTA)) with six tier-matched models from two vendors, 182 blind runs show that cheap models execute plans but rarely succeed alone (the cheapest model: 1 of 11 runs alone, 16 of 17 under a flagship planner; p < 0.001), cheap planners fail more often, and no fixed assignment is cheapest on every task. We propose a learning controller

translated_title: 谁来规划，谁来编辑？面向大语言模型驱动的模拟版图修复的经验证、成本感知的劳动分工
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.24234v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：当签核工具对每一次编辑进行检查时，语言模型智能体能够修复模拟版图，但应由哪个模型负责规划修复、哪个模型负责执行编辑、以及相应的成本是多少，这些仍是悬而未决的问题。在我们的基于工具的修复智能体中，模型只选择有界的版图算子；签核工具在每次编辑后重新运行该任务的契约检查，因此不通过的版图永远不会被接受。在三个设计（一款量产高压数模转换器（DAC）、一款5V振荡器和一款SKY130运算跨导放大器（OTA））的版图与原理图一致性检查（LVS）、设计规则检查（DRC）及后版图修复任务上，使用来自两家供应商的六个同级匹配模型进行的182次盲测运行表明：廉价模型能够执行计划，但很少能独立成功（最便宜的模型：单独运行11次仅成功1次，而在旗舰规划器指导下17次运行成功16次；p < 0.001），廉价的规划器更容易失败，并且不存在在所有任务上都最便宜的固定模型分配方案。我们提出了一个学习控制器（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个由签核工具验证、成本感知的学习控制器，动态决定哪个大语言模型负责规划、哪个负责编辑模拟版图修复任务，实验证明廉价模型在旗舰规划器指导下可高效执行编辑但几乎无法独立成功，且不存在对所有任务都成本最优的固定分工方案。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a verified, cost-aware learning controller that dynamically decides which LLM should plan and which should edit analog layout repairs, showing that cheap models execute plans effectively under a flagship planner but rarely succeed alone, and no fixed assignment is cost-optimal across all tasks.
